findings.issue: joshen is an untranslated transliteration of the common noun חֹשֶׁן (H2833); a common noun must be Spanish.
alzará keeps only the lift sense of qal נָשָׂא (H5375), whose lemma also licenses carry/bear.
siempre is an adverbial smoothing of the absolute noun תָּמִיד (H8548); the continual sense is kept.

notes: Remaining tokens match in participants, number, and names (Aarón, Israel, Jehová).
